items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He loved Art Tatum and Bud Powell, you know.

ctx.x: That makes so much sense, wow.

So Phineas - Them pianists want to play with me cause I - He’s in here! I heard it, I knew! And then they’re still struggling for it, and nobody to this day - I’ve never heard nobody with his facility. Art Tatum, but, you know, I never heard no human being play with his facility and genius. He loved Art Tatum and Bud Powell, you know. But he was...
Right, that’s what I was gonna say, but also you know, he was recording Ravel and putting Ravel with Lush Life together.
